scope: Secondary archive analyses; no native TEST, validation, index 6 or reserved parents. Units nats and lattice sites; all significance refers to parents not spatial translates. Historical native TRAIN reused. No production change.

18.source: first 256 native TRAIN parents at 0,1,2,3,4,5,7,8,9 in release order; no interpolation of held index 6
18.observables: full/permutation/site-mask entropy losses relative to respective exact canonical beta-zero entropies. Absolute total entropy left/right integral bracket using monotonically decreasing canonical mean energy and simultaneous 95% Bonferroni Student parent mean intervals over energy and conditional entropies. At beta zero use exact site coordination hypergeometric mean energy. Conditional species entropy from fixed-A Fourier coefficient and first derivative. Intersect only with physical bounds (nonnegativity, finite support), do not presume marginal mask entropy monotone. No sharp trapezoid conclusions.
18.control: enumerated finite coefficient Shannon entropy; fixed-composition beta-zero combinatorics

24.fit: cold native TRAIN positions 0:4096, 32 independent blocks of 128 each, 48 bath A, 48 bath B, 32 shared references. Hot 0:256 eight blocks of 32 each (12+12 baths, 8 references) as a finite-sample noise diagnostic in addition to analytic null.
24.primary: Let v_r=Var_bath(sum_i[species(r_i)=species(x_i)]) with fixed canonical composition, all translates averaged in covariance estimator only. Cross-covariance of independently estimated v over common references, subtract mean within block using n-1. Relative variance = mean across blocks / square of mean of the two v estimates. Keep signed values. 95% paired block Student delta interval and two-sided interval over cross-cov at .0001 times squared mean using inversion. No truncation to zero for inference.
24.gate: If lower bound on cold relative variance exceeds 0.0001 (1% RMS), fit a linear predictor of v using energy, 7 occupied coordination frequencies and maximum pi-wave vacancy intensity (axes and products), compared with same basis plus occupied fractions of 3 independent optimized-code contrasts. Freeze ridge=0.01 in standardized coordinates before use. Fit on fit reference values with baths independent of development; development and audit use separate baths and references (each 512 parents split into eight 64-parent blocks, 24+24 baths then 16 references). Ask whether adding code improves independently scored mean squared error; useful gain 1% of reference variance. No interpretation of finite-field tails or amorphous freezing.
24.control: beta=0 exact v constant for every fixed-composition reference. Cross-check tiny direct enumeration vs Fourier correlation. Independent bath noise may dominate; report attainable precision and do not call negative cross estimates zero.
